subject.title: [Bug]: Origin validation fails for custom URL schemes (tauri://, electron://)

question: Which exact custom-scheme origin fix path should maintainers advance for this Gateway origin-authorization bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and security-relevant, but two open PRs target the same authorization helper and maintainers need to choose or sponsor the canonical path before this issue can close.

options.title: Advance one exact-origin PR
options.body: Pick the cleaner current-main candidate, require or explicitly override real behavior proof for the auth boundary, and close sibling attempts after merge.

options.title: Pause for broader origin policy
options.body: Defer the exact custom-scheme bug until maintainers decide wildcard or pattern policy, leaving affected users on the wildcard workaround longer.

options.title: Reject custom-scheme allowlisting
options.body: Document wildcard or native-hosting alternatives and accept the security and usability tradeoff for desktop-wrapper origins.

recommendation.title: Advance one exact-origin PR
recommendation.body: Pick the cleaner current-main candidate, require or explicitly override real behavior proof for the auth boundary, and close sibling attempts after merge.
